title: Trilateral Commission donor-side and entity-resolution pass, 2026-08-08
summary: Depth-4 audit of donor-side grant evidence, North American trustee turnover, and exact-name nonprofit identity collisions.

sources.title: Trilateral Commission North America - Nonprofit Explorer
William S Paley Foundation Inc - Nonprofit Explorer
William S Paley Foundation Inc Foundation Profile
William S Paley Foundation Inc - grants schedule

evidence.observation: The FY2025 North American filing lists Richard Fontaine as Executive Director, B. Marc Allen and Carla A. Hills as North American trustees, and Joseph S. Nye Jr. as North American Trustee until 5/25.

IRS Form 990-PF-derived grant tables for the William S. Paley Foundation report general-operating-support grants to Trilateral Commission North America of $10,000 in 2021, $25,000 in 2022, and $25,000 in 2024.

IRS-derived Paley Foundation filing data lists Henry A. Kissinger as Chairman/Director through 11/23; the Trilateral Commission separately maintains historical publications and a 2022 tribute event involving Kissinger.

A separate nonprofit named Trilateral Commission is listed in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania with EIN 25-1804367. This exact-name collision must not be merged with Trilateral Commission North America, EIN 23-7309933, without direct identity evidence.

gaps: The Paley grant rows are exposed through IRS-derived grant parsers; direct raw 990-PF XML line extraction remains preferable for archival-grade grant records.
Broader current donor candidates remain leads until donor-side filings or explicit grant disclosures are verified.
Canadian and Mexican regional legal entities remain unresolved.
The Pittsburgh namesake's full IRS classification should be retained only as a do-not-merge identity warning unless a direct relationship is found.
caveats: A grant does not establish control, policy influence, coordination, or agreement.
Overlapping people or historical participation do not establish that an individual caused or approved a grant.
Exact-name nonprofit matches must be resolved by EIN, jurisdiction, address, and organizational history before graph merging.

workflow.next_action: Convert verified donor-side grants, trustee-year observations, and do-not-merge identity constraints into normalized scripted records after the research PR validation gate passes.

notes: Paley Foundation is a repeat donor-side hit with grants reported in 2021, 2022, and 2024 rather than a one-off grant.
The FY2025 North American filing provides dated trustee information that can improve governance history.
Henry Kissinger's Paley Foundation chair role and separate Trilateral historical participation are both documented, but no causal claim about Paley grants is supported.
EIN 25-1804367 is a distinct Pittsburgh namesake and should be placed on an explicit do-not-merge identity list.

classification_rules: Prefer donor-side 990-PF or explicit donor disclosures for named grant edges.
Record grants with year, amount, purpose, donor identity, recipient identity, and source provenance.
Do not infer influence or coordination from funding or overlapping governance.
Resolve exact-name organizations by EIN and jurisdiction before graph merging.
Keep unresolved donor candidates as targets rather than verified relations.
data.method: Reviewed North American Form 990 trustee data, donor-side Paley Foundation Form 990-PF-derived grant tables, Paley governance data, current Trilateral sources, and exact-name nonprofit collisions.
data.narrative_role: donor-side verification, governance chronology, and entity-resolution skeptic pass
data.research_question: Which named funding edges can be verified from donor-side records, what governance chronology is exposed by annual filings, and which exact-name entities must be excluded from automatic identity merging?

findings.finding: The FY2025 filing exposes dated North American trustee turnover and officer data.
The William S. Paley Foundation is a repeat donor-side hit to Trilateral Commission North America in 2021, 2022, and 2024.
Henry Kissinger's Paley Foundation chair role overlaps historically with separately documented Trilateral participation, but no causal grant-influence claim is supported.
A Pittsburgh nonprofit with EIN 25-1804367 is an exact-name collision and must not be automatically merged with the North American Trilateral entity, EIN 23-7309933.
Broader donor candidates should remain unresolved until donor-side filings or explicit disclosures are verified.
